name: kallikrat
description: Construction plans from the conversation. Bundles the kallikrat-plans skill + the hosted Kallikrat MCP server (kallikrat.com) so Codex can draw and edit plans as IFC models, show plan sheets and a live 3D view in the chat, record what was built differently, and issue revisions as PDF, IFC and BCF. Sign in on first use.

interface.shortDescription: Draw construction plans and document what was built.
interface.longDescription: Describe a building and Kallikrat turns it into an IFC model: walls, rooms, doors, windows, slabs, roofs, stairs, terrain and materials, in millimetres. See each storey as a plan sheet or the whole model in 3D inside the chat, import a PDF plan or a photo of a paper one, record what was built differently on site, and issue revisions as PDF, IFC and BCF. Sign in on first use.
